decisions.reason: The protection cap is closely related to the firm's existing accessory and trailer know-how, so it is likely to be retained, though as a small peripheral item with limited prominence it still has some discontinuation risk.
A box car trailer series sits squarely in the firm's core trailer capabilities and its home-page visibility suggests it is important enough for the firm to keep and refine.

The car transporter trailer is still related to the firm's established trailer knowledge, but as a more specialized line it carries somewhat more risk if early market feedback is harder to interpret without strong R&D signals.
The low-bed trailer series matches the firm's long-accumulated production, logistics, and service knowledge and its prominent website placement points toward continuation.

The high trailer cover series complements the firm's established trailer business and can be supported through existing production and after-sales capabilities, though add-on products are somewhat easier to prune if demand is modest.

This box car trailer series is also highly related to the firm's core knowledge and was prominently marketed, but some chance of portfolio rationalization remains because it overlaps with another box trailer line.
